context: Evaluates correct definition and attachment of JSON Schema objects to Fastify route options for both validation and serialization. The candidate must attach schemas for body, querystring, and response within the route's schema option. Focus is entirely on Fastify's schema system, not on general JSON Schema knowledge.

checklist.name: body schema
checklist.description: Attaches a JSON Schema to the route's `schema.body` option with the correct required fields and types for the POST /users route

checklist.name: querystring schema
checklist.description: Attaches a JSON Schema to `schema.querystring` with integer types for the GET /users pagination parameters

checklist.name: response schema
checklist.description: Attaches a JSON Schema to `schema.response['201']` (or '2xx') that lists only the fields to expose, so that extra fields are stripped during serialization

checklist.name: Schema placement in route options
checklist.description: Places the schema object inside the route's options argument (second argument to app.post()/app.get()), not outside

checklist.name: required array usage
checklist.description: Uses the JSON Schema `required` array at the correct level to mark mandatory fields as required
